components.name: Button
semantics: visible action label
loading preserves name and prevents duplicate activation
disabled is native where possible

components.name: IconButton
semantics: nonempty accessible name required
icon is aria-hidden
visible tooltip supplements but never supplies the sole name

components.name: LinkButton
semantics: fragment navigation or a named local blob download only
disabled removes href and exposes aria-disabled without emulating button activation

components.name: Badge
semantics: short static classification
state includes text or icon and never hue alone

components.name: Kbd
semantics: visual key hint has equivalent prose context
does not register shortcuts

components.name: Separator
semantics: decorative separators use role none
semantic separator declares orientation

components.name: Skeleton
semantics: never focusable
real status text is separate
reduced motion removes shimmer

components.name: Spinner
semantics: accessible loading name required
reduced motion uses static progress glyph

components.name: VisuallyHidden
semantics: content remains in accessibility tree
focusable descendant becomes visibly revealed

components.name: Card
keyboard: none unless an explicit child action owns activation
semantics: container is not a giant button
interactive children are not nested inside an interactive card

components.name: EmptyState
semantics: names what is empty
offers a safe next action when one exists

components.name: StatusPill
semantics: static text and icon identify status without hue alone
time-sensitive communication is solely the responsibility of the owning application state region
StatusPill has computed role none

components.name: Progress
semantics: labelled determinate or indeterminate progress
value bounds are explicit

components.name: Meter
semantics: scalar measurement not task progress
min max low high optimum are explicit

components.name: Field
semantics: binds one label help and error to one control
error text names preservation and next action

components.name: Label
semantics: visible label is preferred
for references exactly one control id

components.name: Input
keyboard: Escape is field-local only when documented
semantics: labelled
aria-invalid and described error agree
global shortcuts inactive while editing

components.name: Textarea
semantics: multiline state exposed
resize cannot obscure transport or escape viewport

components.name: NumberField
keyboard: typed value remains local until commit
semantics: min max step and unit are explicit
out-of-range value refuses rather than clamps silently

components.name: Select
semantics: native select is default
null is an explicit no-selection value and may be committed
placeholder is not a hidden valid value

components.name: Combobox
semantics: expanded controls and active descendant references are exact
free text selected value and explicit null selection remain distinct

components.name: Listbox
semantics: selection and active focus are distinct
disabled options are skipped

components.name: Checkbox
keyboard: Space commits one explicit boolean value
semantics: checked and mixed are exposed exactly
change event preserves previousValue including mixed and carries an explicit boolean value
component never guesses a hidden prior boolean

components.name: RadioGroup
semantics: group has visible legend or accessible name
exactly zero or one selected as policy declares
null change explicitly clears selection when the owner permits it

components.name: Switch
semantics: checked state and on or off text are both visible
does not use mixed state

components.name: Slider
keyboard: PageUp and PageDown change declared large step
Home and End move exact bounds
semantics: preview is ephemeral and one final intent commits
value text includes musical unit

components.name: SegmentedControl
semantics: single selection only
orientation matches arrow behavior

components.name: Toggle
semantics: pressed state is exposed
visible label does not change so name remains stable

components.name: ToggleGroup
semantics: single or multiple mode is explicit
group name required

components.name: Tabs
keyboard: Enter or Space activates in manual mode
semantics: one selected tab
controls and labelledby references are reciprocal

components.name: Breadcrumb
semantics: current item has aria-current=page
visual separators are hidden

components.name: Toolbar
semantics: toolbar has accessible name
disabled items remain discoverable but skipped by roving focus

components.name: Menu
semantics: trigger expanded and controls are exact
flattened depth-first item count includes separators and nested items
depth four and 200 flattened items are hard bounds
one action per menuitem

components.name: ContextMenu
keyboard: Shift+F10 or ContextMenu opens at target
semantics: every action is also reachable through a visible menu
pointer-only invocation is forbidden
shares flattened menu depth cycle and identity laws

components.name: CommandPalette
semantics: uses the sole modal scope
query and active option are distinct
results are deterministically ordered

components.name: Disclosure
semantics: expanded and controls references are exact
collapsed content is not focusable

components.name: Accordion
keyboard: Home and End optionally move bounds
semantics: heading levels fit document outline
single or multiple expansion policy is explicit

components.name: ScrollArea
components.semantic: div[tabindex=0] only when no focusable child provides access
keyboard: no smooth scroll in reduced motion
semantics: native overflow remains operable
custom scrollbar cannot hide platform affordance

components.name: RovingFocus
keyboard: Arrow keys move by declared orientation
semantics: exactly one enabled item has tabindex zero
stable IDs survive reorder
work is bounded by item count

components.name: Tooltip
semantics: never receives focus
describedby is present only while visible
not the sole accessible name
pointer close delay is 100 ms

components.name: Popover
semantics: nonmodal descendant of one dismissal layer
visible close required when persistent

components.name: Dialog
keyboard: Tab and Shift+Tab stay in active scope
visible Close and Cancel activate natively
semantics: label description initial focus and dismissibility are explicit
blocked dismissal retains visible disabled Close and Cancel with a reason
background is inert
one modal scope only

components.name: AlertDialog
keyboard: Tab and Shift+Tab stay in active scope
semantics: nonempty description names destructive consequence and preserved data
safe action receives initial focus
dismissibility and cancellation reason are explicit

components.name: SheetDrawer
keyboard: Escape closes when active and dismissible
visible Close and Cancel activate natively
semantics: modal sheet becomes the sole active dialog
nonmodal sheet remains in document flow
kind and mode obey overlayKindModes
chart and mobile transport remain visible

components.name: ToastNotice
semantics: deduplicated by stable notice identity
never covers mobile transport
urgent role reserved for immediate hazards

components.name: FocusDismissLayer
keyboard: Escape visits bounded owner ancestry from topmost
Tab containment only for modal scope
semantics: one active modal scope
at most four descendant nonmodal surfaces
stale trigger uses declared stable fallback
listeners are component scoped

components.name: KeyValueList
keyboard: interactive values use their own native controls
semantics: dt and dd ordering is preserved
visual columns reflow without changing reading order

components.name: DataTable
keyboard: body cells are text only and never receive interactive descendants
sorting button activates with Enter or Space
semantics: caption or accessible name required
body renderText output is bounded text only
sort state and button name expose ascending or descending
sort change carries columnId and direction together or null
mobile alternative preserves all headers

components.name: Tree
keyboard: ArrowUp and ArrowDown move visible items
semantics: rooted forest requires unique reciprocal parent and child references
all nodes are reachable from roots and cycles refuse
levels setsizes and positions are correct when not DOM-derived
selection is distinct from focus

components.name: ResizablePanels
keyboard: Home and End move declared bounds
semantics: separator exposes orientation value min max and now
collapse emits a separate exact collapsed-ID change event
collapse has visible restore action
pointer capture releases on cancel and unmount

components.name: TimelineLane
keyboard: Arrow keys move through declared lane order
Move Previous and Move Next replace drag requirement
semantics: exact beat labels accompany geometry
selection and playhead are distinct
no operation depends on drag or color
